info.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 25 at 2:29PM EDT until September 27 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Gray ME
info.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 7 to 12 feet and a high risk of rip currents. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding with up to 1 foot of inundation and large breaking waves leading to splash over and beach erosion. This is a long duration event...with these impacts felt over multiple tide cycles beginning Saturday morning and continuing through Sunday evening.
* WHERE...In Maine, Coastal York County. In New Hampshire, Coastal Rockingham County.
* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 8 PM EDT Sunday. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 10 AM Saturday to 11 PM EDT Sunday.
* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only isolated road closures expected. Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach erosion.
info.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property.
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions.
